name: Temu Frame Perfect Counter
description: An independent input timeline recorder with a HUD, colored press markers, and CSV export.

show-markers.name: Show input markers
show-markers.description: Draw a colored marker at the player's position when a press is recorded.

record-inputs.name: Record inputs
record-inputs.description: Record press and release events for CSV analysis.

reset-on-death.name: Reset data on death
reset-on-death.description: Start a fresh recording after a death.
